text:
Mira: FYI PR #14221 is hitting flaky failures on CI, linux-x64 shard. 6/10 runs failed with the same snapshot diffs. holding merge until we decide next step :thinking:

Tom: thanks Mira. can you paste the failing test names? seems like a snapshot mismatch, could be env noise. :eyes:

Mira: here are the failing lines from the job logs: 
```
FAIL tests/integration/kv_cache.test.ts › KV cache prefix preservation › snapshot mismatch
Snapshot name: KvCache -- prefix 32bytes
Expected: "..."
Received: "..."
```
Also see flaky timingouts on the same shard before the snapshot failures.

Anita: I just pushed a small change to how newlines are serialized in the prefix writer (not in this PR). Could be related. i'll take a look and try a local reproduce. If it's just snapshot drift we can either update snapshots in this PR or rerun CI after rebase.

Max: rebase + rerun is quickest IMO. CI sometimes flakes on that shard when run concurrently. To rerun locally: `yarn test -i tests/integration/kv_cache.test.ts -t "prefix preservation"`
To rerun the whole suite in CI: use the rerun button or POST to the CI API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://ci.internal/retry?job=2028001234 -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN"
```

ci-bot: Build 2028001234 (PR 14221) — rerun requested by tom. Queued on runner pool.

Tom: also we need 1 more approval from infra or runtime owning the KV cache change. @anita can you self-approve once you confirm snapshot is unrelated?

Anita: i can't approve my own PR, but i can +1 and ask charlie to approve if it's safe. i'll try to reproduce now and post results in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Reminder: merge window is open until 17:00 UTC. If this doesn't clear before then we'll schedule for next window (tomorrow).

Charlie: quick check — if this is snapshot-only and a legit output change from your previous PR that adjusted serialization, we should update snapshots and mark the change in the changelog. If it's nondeterministic, we must fix the test or add a retry/guard. don't merge flaky snapshots. :no_entry_sign:

Mira: agree. i'm going to attach the failing job logs and a small repro script to the PR so reviewers can run quickly.

Tom: pinging eng-oncall for extra CI runner capacity if needed.

ci-bot: Rerun succeeded on attempt 2 (2028001248). 1 flaky test still failed (kv_cache.test). Full log: https://ci.internal/builds/2028001248

Max: still failing consistently on attempt 2? that suggests a code-level regression or environment change. Anita, any luck reproducing?

Anita: reproduced locally with Node 18.15, failing snapshot identical. i can prepare a minimal repro branch to demonstrate. Plan: add fix to prefix writer + run suite. If it fixes, we'll update snapshots and request approvals.

Tom: thanks. can you drop the repro branch link here when ready and i'll queue a dedicated CI run with isolated runners.

Mira: noted. holding merge and marking PR as "ci-investigating" label. i'll also add a short note in the PR summary about merge window impact.

Charlie: thanks team. if you need me to approve after the fix, @charlie will do final sign-off — please tag me with the PR link. :thumbsup:

Mira: will do.

(Reaction summary: Mira :eyes:, Tom :thumbsup:, Anita :hourglass_flowing_sand: )
